mapper.sql: select v.vehicle_id, v.vehicle_type, v.model_name, v.title, v.guide_price, v.original_price, v.color, v.stock, v.merchant_id, v.description, v.tags, v.view_count, v.status, v.create_time, v.update_time, m.merchant_name, s.range_km, s.battery_capacity, s.charge_time_fast, s.charge_time_slow, s.model_year from stad_vehicle v left join stad_merchant m on v.merchant_id = m.merchant_id left join stad_vehicle_spec s on v.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id
